1.w: A Psalm. Sing to YHWH a new song, for He has done wonders! His right hand has gained victory for Him, even the arm of His holiness.

2.w: YHWH has made known His victory; before the eyes of the nations, He has revealed His righteousness.

3.w: He has remembered His kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.

4.w: Shout joyfully to YHWH, all the earth; break forth and cry aloud and sing praises!

5.w: Sing praises to YHWH with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody!

6.w: With the trumpets and the voice of the shofar, shout joyfully before the face of YHWH the King!

7.w: Let the sea roar, and its fullness, the world, and those dwelling in it!

8.w: Let the rivers clap the hands; let the hills cry aloud together,

9.w: before the face of YHWH—for He is coming to judge the earth! He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with uprightness!
